title: Billing Rules — Correcting Over-Billed Residential Natural Gas Supply Lines
content:
**Rule 1 — rebill credit.** When a Residential Natural Gas Supply line was billed at more than the policy allows, the over-billed amount is returned as one rebill credit tied to that line.

**Rule 2 — amount (retired clause).** The former clause read: the rebill credit equals the billed amount minus the correctly computed amount for the same line, rounded half up to the cent, posted as a negative amount, and a fee line that should not have been billed is corrected in full. **This clause is no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.

**Rule 3 — lookback.** A gas line may be corrected only when the customer disputes it no later than the plan's correction lookback — 12 calendar months on every plan — after the line was posted. The lookback ends on the same day of the month 12 months after the posting date, or on the last day of that month when that day does not exist; the end day is included. The posting date is read from the company's record of the disputed line.

**Rule 4 — once per line.** Each billed gas line may be corrected only once, as judged from the rebill credits already tied to that line.

**Rule 5 — care agent limit (retired clause).** The former clause read: a care agent may post a rebill credit up to the agent adjustment limit, and a larger correction is opened as a gas billing dispute for review instead of being posted. **This clause is no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.

**Rule 6 — what is not corrected.** Under-billing caused by a Beacon Ridge error is not back-billed, and therm readings measured by the utility are not corrected by Beacon Ridge.

### Lookback boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Line posted | Lookback ends | Disputed on | Correction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 31 August 2024 | 31 August 2025 | 31 August 2025 | may be corrected |
| 31 August 2024 | 31 August 2025 | 1 September 2025 | may not be corrected |
| 29 February 2024 | 28 February 2025 (29 February 2025 does not exist) | 28 February 2025 | may be corrected |
| 29 February 2024 | 28 February 2025 | 1 March 2025 | may not be corrected |

### Points of judgement

- A line that already carries a rebill credit is not corrected a second time.
- A customer who reports being billed too little is not back-billed when the shortfall came from a Beacon Ridge error.
- A dispute about the therms the utility measured is not a correction Beacon Ridge makes.
